instruction: You're facing a window, if you turn right you will notice a glass dining room table in front of you with some white chairs around it, to your left there's going to be a wall with a mirror. Walk to towards the right corner of that wall with the mirror, and turn slightly right. You will notice there is an open door that leads to a bathroom, walk into that bathroom and stand in front of the mirror and turn around. Look slightly to your right, you'll see there's a wooden wall with an oven of the reflection of an oven. Walk towards that wooden wall, turn to your right and you will see the kitchen island on your left, some cabinets on your right side, keep walking straight past the cabinets and the stairways on your right, walk past the kitchen island on your left, until you see to your right there is a black handrail and a living room further ahead, there are grey furniture, walk to that living room until you're standing in front of the grey sofa with a blue sheet on it. That's your spot. There's going to be a planter on your right side.
